title: Chapter 2666 - 75: Killing Intent (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 2666: Chapter 75: Killing Intent (Part 2)

Following that, without waiting for Dan Zhu to speak further, he said coldly:

"Alright, if you’re going to save people, then just focus on saving them. Don’t interfere in other matters, don’t even think about encroaching on the lands seized by our Bi Fang Tribe."

"That way, our wells won’t interfere with the river, otherwise, don’t blame our Bi Fang Tribe for being rude."

Bi Jie spoke arrogantly.

Ba Shan couldn’t help it and wanted to curse him.

But Dan Zhu stopped him and shook his head.

At such times, saving lives should be the priority. If disputes and fighting arose from a moment of verbal friction, leading to greater injuries, it would be unwise.

Dan Zhu nodded, "Fine." Yet he didn’t want to show weakness, so he said with a piercing gaze:

"Your Bi Fang Tribe, if you keep your word, we won’t act, otherwise our Danque Tribe will not spare you lightly either."

Bi Jie smiled and shook his head, "Boy, trying to sound tough, you’re still too naive."

Dan Zhu tightly pursed his lips.

Both Ba Shan and Ba Chuan glared angrily at Bi Jie.

Bi Jie sneered and ignored them, turning to his Bi Fang Tribe subordinates and said:

"Do our own thing, kill all the Shugu Tribe members, seize the territory, treat these Danque Tribe people as mere wooden logs, no need to pay attention."

"Yes!" The members of the Bi Fang Tribe responded, tinged with mockery in their tone.

The faces of the Danque Tribe were filled with anger.

After that, neither side said anything more, only Bi Jie and Dan Zhu exchanged a glance, their eyes clashed fiercely and then they parted ways.

Bi Jie led the Bi Fang Tribe, continuing their attack on the Shugu Tribe, rampaging through it.

Dan Zhu led the Danque Tribe’s barbarian soldiers, avoiding the conflict, to rescue their own people.

The large groups of both sides gradually moved away.

As they reached a secluded place, after dispatching a few Shugu Tribe barbarian cultivators, Bi Jie’s cocky expression turned sinister, and he cursed under his breath:

"Damn it, it’s a pity, I was planning to cut down that pretty boy in one strike. Then suddenly change my move, catch him off guard, and with cultivation pressure, kill Dan Zhu."

"Even if I couldn’t kill him, I’d cut off one of his arms."

"But I didn’t expect Chi Feng, that old bastard, to be so cautious, blocking all my moves, leaving me no chance to strike."

"Otherwise, Dan Zhu, that little brat, would be done for today..."

Bi Jie said with some regret. Then his expression darkened slightly, and after some careful thinking, he still resolutely declared:

"No, Dan Zhu still has to be killed!"

He turned to a few Golden Core members of the Bi Fang Tribe beside him and instructed:

"Later, we’ll look for opportunities, find an excuse to slowly get close to them, then strike with full force without a word, ensuring we kill Dan Zhu directly with thunderous methods!"

Bi Jie’s face showed ferocity.

Beside Bi Jie, a Golden Core Middle Phase Elder from the Bi Fang Tribe frowned and voiced his concern, "Wouldn’t this anger the Danque Tribe?"

Bi Jie sneered, "So what?"

Several elders of the Bi Fang Tribe hesitated somewhat.

Bi Jie then said darkly, "Core Formation is so hard, you and I are aware. But this Golden Core, Dan Zhu achieved it at twenty, can you imagine the terrifying talent? Leaving him alive will certainly be a major problem!"

"I have long since wanted to kill him by any means necessary, but the Danque Tribe protects him so well, I can’t even touch a strand of his hair."

"Now this Danque Tribe seems to be acting strangely, suddenly releasing Dan Zhu... and just happened to run into our Bi Fang Tribe, isn’t this heaven’s plain invitation giving us the opportunity?"

"I even feel this might be heaven’s only chance given to our Bi Fang Tribe."

"This opportunity is fleeting."

"If we falter, hesitate, lack the determination, fail to seize this chance, don’t go all out to kill Dan Zhu, once he grows into a formidable leader, it’ll be too late for regrets."

"The survival of a tribe often hinges between fierce determination and momentary hesitation!"

Bi Jie spoke fervently, eyes blazing with ambition.

The surrounding Golden Core Elders of the Bi Fang Tribe were shaken by his words.

Their Young Master truly was inherently decisive and courageous, with an exceptionally keen intuition.

When it comes to enemies, he kills decisively, never hesitates, never misses the slightest opportunity.

Likewise, his ambition and tactics commanded respect.

No wonder the Late Golden Core Chief Elder in the tribe wholeheartedly submitted to this Young Master.

This was the hope for the rise of the Bi Fang Tribe.

The Golden Core Elders of the Bi Fang Tribe all showed dark expressions and nodded, "We obey the Young Master’s command."

"If there’s an opportunity, we must kill Dan Zhu!"

...

On the other side.

The Danque Tribe gathered together.

Mo Hua saw there was no one else around and spoke softly, "Later, if possible, try to kill that Bi Jie kid first..."

Dan Zhu and the others were startled.

Even Chi Feng gave Mo Hua a surprised look.

"This... won’t be easy..." Ba Shan said quietly.

Since being "rescued" by Mo Hua, the shaman lord, Ba Shan had indeed become more subdued, acknowledging Mo Hua’s authority in his heart, not daring to argue against everything.

His words weren’t opposition, but rather a very objective concern.

Bi Jie is at the Golden Core Middle Phase, talented and highly cultivated, surrounded by powerful Golden Core members of the Bi Fang Tribe and several barbarian cultivators from the Bi Fang Tribe.

Mo Hua nodded, "Which is why I said ’if possible’. If possible, kill him, if not, there’s no need to force it, but never lose the will to kill."

Ba Chuan frowned and said, "Mr. Witch, while our Danque Tribe doesn’t see eye to eye with the Bi Fang Tribe, it’s not enough to secretly assassinate their Young Master, that’ll create a blood feud."

Mo Hua replied, "Bi Jie is ambitious like a ravenous wolf; if you don’t kill their Young Master, they will surely kill yours."
